info.description: A focused slice of the Hugging Face Hub API: models, datasets, Spaces, papers, collections and users (read operations). Cut from https://huggingface.co/.well-known/openapi.json; the model, dataset and Space list/info endpoints come from spec/supplement.json because the published file does not include them.
info.summary: A focused slice of the Hugging Face Hub API: models, datasets, Spaces, papers, collections and users (read operations).
info.title: Hugging Face Hub API

text.about_md: An unofficial SDK for a focused, read-only slice of the Hugging Face Hub API, generated with the Voxgig SDK generator. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hugging Face. The spec slice and the reasons for it are in `spec/README.md`.

entity_desc.auth: The account behind the API token (whoami). Needs HUGGINGFACE_HUB_APIKEY.
entity_desc.collection: A curated collection of repos and papers.
entity_desc.daily_paper: An entry in Daily Papers: a paper plus who submitted it and when.
entity_desc.dataset: A dataset repository, addressed by namespace and repo.
entity_desc.model: A model repository, addressed by namespace and repo (for example openai-community / gpt2).
entity_desc.paper: A paper on hf.co/papers, addressed by its arXiv id. List with $action search to search.
entity_desc.profile: A user profile overview, addressed by username.
entity_desc.space: A Space (a hosted demo app), addressed by namespace and repo.
entity_desc.trending: One trending repo (model, dataset or Space) from the Hub front page.

text.summary: The Hugging Face Hub hosts open models, datasets and demo apps (Spaces). This SDK covers its public read API.
text.tagline: Search and read models, datasets, Spaces, papers and collections on the Hugging Face Hub.
text.title: Hugging Face Hub
